note: 与其他 Emissary 共享“自称国王最喜欢的委托官,来要某种物品”的玩笑式台词模板,详见 Emissary_Braum.json 的说明和 GLOSSARY.md。

messages.context: 无进行中委托时的开场白,自称国王最喜欢的委托官,来采购东西
messages.text: The King has sent me to go shopping for I am his favorite emissary!
messages.zh: 国王派我出来采购,因为我是他最喜欢的委托官!
messages.raw: §fThe King has sent me to go shopping for I am his favorite emissary!

messages.text: This will make me gain even more favor with the King!
messages.zh: 这样我在国王心里的地位会更高!
messages.raw: §fThis will make me gain even more favor with the King!

messages.context: 拒绝/取消委托时的台词
messages.text: How dare you reject me, the King's favorite emissary?!
messages.zh: 你竟敢拒绝我,国王最喜欢的委托官?!
messages.raw: §fHow dare you reject me, the King's favorite emissary?!
